ALEX RULING (2026-07-29): the frag refutation surfaced only because ALEX asked "does the frag render?" — that is a LOOP FAILURE, not a probe success. Enforcement added to BEB-2436 §6 (BINDING TRUTH GATE): (6.1) no lane may claim/refine/complete against an unprobed binding — repo readable, worker host rendered_has_content post-JS, route present; a failed binding is a BLOCKING spec_ask, never substituted with a plausible one. (6.2) new red BINDING_UNRESOLVABLE — fires immediately on any proposed/claimed ticket carrying a dead binding, not after N passes, and reaches the wake report unprompted. (6.3) new red SPEC_DONE_NO_SURFACE — spec docs done with no rendering surface is RED, not progress; "4/7 spec docs done" with zero deployed workers must never read as advancement. (6.4) acceptance E: the gate must catch a hallucinated binding with no human in the path.
